# Exercise bound callees, boxed receivers, resultless instances, and tuple captures.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_defer_binding_review335.lgo option_defer_binding_review335/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_defer_binding_review335.out option_defer_binding_review335/expected.txt
cd option_defer_binding_review335
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_option_resultless_review335.lgo comptime_option_resultless_review335/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/comptime_option_resultless_review335.out comptime_option_resultless_review335/expected.txt
cd comptime_option_resultless_review335
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_defer_multi_review335.lgo option_defer_multi_review335/main.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_defer_multi_review335.out option_defer_multi_review335/expected.txt
cd option_defer_multi_review335
logos run .
cmp stdout expected.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
cmp stdout ../expected.txt
env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd ../..
